prompts.label: standing-white
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW, carefully proportioned FULL-BODY manga illustration of the SAME FluxRail girl in the supplied identity/style reference. The reference is a bust; extend her into a complete balanced figure, do not simply stretch the bust. Critical anatomy: approximately FOUR heads tall measured from natural top of head (excluding hat) to soles, a modestly oversized cute head around one quarter of height, SHORT COMPACT torso, natural small hips underneath skirt, clearly longer proportionate legs. Lower body (hips to soles) should be about half the total body height. Visible legs from skirt hem to soles occupy about 38-42% of total height. Skirt hem near 58% of figure height; natural knees near 77%; shoes at 96-100%. Thigh and calf lengths comparable, slender but soft leg contours, knees and ankles align naturally, two separate normal legs, no inward collapsed knees, no bowed shins, no stumpy legs, no oversized torso, no stretched feet. Standing comfortably upright with only a mild natural bend, both shoes flat and plausible. Preserve the original face rather than enlarging it to dominate the body. Keep the exact identity: fluffy pale sky-blue bob, side curls, round face, dark blue hand-hatched manga eyes, hatch blush, tiny shy open mouth, white beret with muted blue-grey band and pink star, white waterdrop hairclip. Outfit: reference white loose sailor blouse with roomy sleeves but compact torso, grey-blue sailor collar and bow; simple grey-blue pleated skirt with two white hem stripes; rounded white-and-blue low closed-toe shoes, moderate size, subtle pink fastening accents. All legs covered with thick opaque matte tights continuously from beneath skirt to shoes, absolutely no bare knee or visible skin. Soft low-saturation sky-blue #c8e4f4, blue-grey ink #426782, muted navy eye details #304f66, collar/skirt #5b86a2, pale pink #e9b5cd, warm white skin #fff9f6. Quiet fine hand-drawn manga linework and restrained flat color, reference visual style, very cute but balanced four-head figure. Clean isolated cutout on ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background, NO background glow, NO haze, NO aura, NO ground shadow, NO vignette, NO sparkles, NO gradient backdrop. Only character and requested prop. Opaque white fills inside the character. Vertical portrait canvas, complete hat and both shoes with comfortable transparent margin, not cropped. No text, watermark, scene or additional character. Pose: relaxed standing, arms hanging naturally with small hands just below blouse cuffs, feet a small distance apart, gentle shy smile. Plain thick matte WHITE opaque tights, faint blue-grey contour shadow only, smooth fit. No controller/prop.
